remaining_blockers.detail: with graph mode (default), drafter.dummy_run -> qwen3_dflash forward AOT-compile raises torch.fx.experimental.symbolic_shapes.PendingUnbackedSymbolNotFound: Pending unbacked symbols {u0} not in returned outputs FakeTensor(size=(s72,5120)). A data-dependent (unbacked SymInt) op in the DFlash drafter fake/meta path is not threaded through returned outputs.
remaining_blockers.workaround: --enforce-eager (used for this measurement) -> bypasses AOT compile, spec runs. Graph-mode tok/s (the real >100 target regime) remains unmeasured until this compile bug is fixed in the drafter model (qwen3_dflash.py) / its fake impl.
remaining_blockers.status: RESOLVED (2026-08-21, verified live graph mode) — see graph_mode section
remaining_blockers.resolution: Root cause: BACKED dynamic shapes (token dim s72 backed), so u0 is a genuine data-dependent unbacked SymInt. Minted by F.embedding -> local_scalar_dense (vocab_parallel_embedding.py:78, torch _subclasses/fake_impls.py:828) because the DFlash drafter embedded input_ids INSIDE its @support_torch_compile forward (qwen3_dflash.py:445), where fake tracing can't prove ids in-range (vpe-fix tp==1 masking under scalar_asserts). u0 (=(s72,5120) output has no u0) -> PendingUnbackedSymbolNotFound. The target avoids this by receiving inputs_embeds (embed outside compile). Fix: DFlashProposer now embeds outside into the cudagraph-stable self.inputs_embeds buffer at both self.model() call sites (dummy_run, build_model_inputs_first_pass), passing inputs_embeds/input_ids=None, mirroring SpecDecodeBaseProposer. Numerically identical; graph mode compiles (drafter 4.9s).
